##### Homogeneous network interference

We introduce the assumption of [*homogeneous network interference*](#def-homogenous-network-interference), which reduces the complexity of network exposure mappings. This achieved through three conditions:
i) The structural equation is [separable](#def-separatability) into component functions which are
ii) [positionally invariant](#def-positional-invariance), and 
iii) [bounded](#def-boundedness).

This assumption holds that for any node in the network, the effect of a neighbor’s treatment is the same regardless of which neighbor it is, and regardless of the position of the unit in the network.  In addition, network exposure mappings are further restricted so that their values lie in a finite set.
